summary: Build and debug RAG pipelines with measured retrieval quality and grounded answers.
intents: our rag chatbot gives answers that are not in the documents
choose a chunk size and overlap for our knowledge base
add hybrid bm25 and vector search to our retriever
measure recall at k for our document search
make the assistant cite which document each answer came from
users see documents they should not have access to in rag results
not_for: training an embedding model from scratch
prerequisites: the corpus and how it changes
sample questions with known answers or source documents
verify: Retrieval was measured separately from generation
Answers cite passages and admit when the passages are insufficient
Access filtering happens before passages reach the model
